title: 49ers had visits with OTs Caleb Lomu, Kadyn Proctor

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers had visits with OTs Caleb Lomu, Kadyn Proctor
sources.description: The 49ers remain optimistic that they will come to agreement with left tackle Trent Williams on a revised contract for the 2026 season, but Williams won't be on the roster forever and the team's pre-draft work has included meetings with a couple of the top tackles in this year's class.
